digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Thursday, November 26 is a US holiday, with two meetings on the calendar and eight carried-over items, including one urgent item. Focus on Wave 2 coverage, MHE decisions and the overdue training. Outbound SMS and voicemail routing have been restored. Dashboard state was last updated November 16, so completion and reminder information may be stale.

items.label: Confirm Wave 2 recovery and coverage
items.detail: Tier 2 went live Tuesday; six queues are scheduled for December 1-2. Jenn still flags deployment risk from staffing and approximately 164 active users missing language skills. Confirm coverage and the audit follow-up with Thiago. Voicemail routing was subsequently reported restored.

items.label: Check the RFE MHE decision with Mar
items.detail: Screening standards can be used for the identified pilot groups, but the prior correspondence left mandatory evaluations and other decisions unresolved. Confirm Angel's answers and the path to IT.

items.label: Check MHE approvals and pilot readiness
items.detail: Confirm approvals, provider onboarding and the revised pilot date with Mar. The pilot did not start November 20.

items.label: Check the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: The November 25 notice still lists Dominican Republic harassment prevention training as overdue. Check its current status in Rippling.

items.label: Confirm Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: Jean told Anu that Isabella was recently assigned as BA and discussions had not yet started; IT still needs requirements to create stories. Confirm the project lead and next steps.

items.label: Follow up on Re-Open Cases closure
items.detail: Gustavo will lead from Product and prepare a one-pager for Cory and Jeff. At the December 1 follow-up, the group plans to review the existing workflow, Legal language and Intake Support checklist, then assign remaining owners and dates.

items.label: Follow up on the Power BI assignment
items.detail: The November 5 reporting request was unassigned and blocking the project for selling services to leads with ongoing cases. Check the request sent to Matthew; Leandro and Kevin were waiting for an assignment.

items.label: Follow up on EKM dependencies and timing
items.detail: Pilot stories passed grooming, but Legal capacity, approval governance, Salesforce migration and delivery dates remained open. Confirm ownership and timing ahead of the pilot.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Armando 1:1
items.detail: The Amazon Connect standup at the same time was canceled. A blocked hour follows at noon.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem! weekly meeting
items.detail: The calendar marks the US Thanksgiving holiday today. Jean and Sara's 1:1 is canceled. Times are AST; the early afternoon is otherwise open on the calendar.

items.label: Sara is out through December 4
items.detail: Her coverage note routes time approvals and PTO to Danny and asks that legal delays or conflicting guidance be escalated to him.

items.label: Friday - holiday and executive slide update
items.detail: The calendar marks the US holiday and an out-of-office entry. Executive Project Status Slide Update appears at 3:00 PM AST; the EPMO management meeting, IT sync and Amazon Connect standup show as canceled.
